Implemented hybrid retrieval combining FAISS and BM25 using Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
Integrated XGBoost hallucination classifier and toxicity model ensemble.

outcomes.claim: Validated context-aware AI governance middleware with nine-node state machine, hybrid retrieval, parallel auditing, and compliance retrieval via Streamlit and LangSmith.
